rules.why: Hermes 0.21 and 0.22 paint a ready status row above the input composer after startup, session slash acknowledgements and completed turns. The elapsed-time row keeps repainting at rest, so quiet is not required. Startup and running turns replace ready; unsubmitted slash commands occupy the composer. A fresh launch shows one placeholder from Hermes' fixed set.

rows.regex: ^❯(?: Try "[^"]+"(?: for commands)?| Ask me anything…)?$

rules.why: A readable screen without the ready footer and available composer is still starting, handling input, running a turn or showing a picker; a quiet process cannot prove otherwise.
